breakdown.description: Claiming to run a 2D simulation but using wall (noSlip) boundary conditions on front/back faces instead of empty.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly uses 'empty' boundary conditions on the front and back patches for all fields (U, T, k, epsilon, nut, alphat, p, p_rgh), matching the ground truth. The original error of using noSlip/wall on front/back was identified and corrected.
